name: URL Coupons by Smart Coupons for WooCommerce
author: storeapps

sections.description:
Auto apply discounts for your customers in one click of the URL. Add any personalized coupon code to any custom URL on your site to apply discounts. No more coupon code hassles!

Here’s a unique coupon URL – https://www.example.com/christmas-hamper?coupon-code=merry.

Share URL coupon code via emails, affiliate partners, blog posts, social media and other channels and give your marketing campaigns the desired boost.

With one click, shoppers automatically receive their discounts, creating a seamless experience that drives faster checkouts and sales.

The easiest URL Coupons by Smart Coupons for WooCommerce plugin, supporting all default WooCommerce coupon types.

Making best use of URL Coupons by Smart Coupons for WooCommerce

  • Create personalized WooCommerce coupon URLs for seasonal campaigns, Black Friday sales or specific events. This enhances the customer experience and boosts conversions. For instance – https://www.example.com/?coupon-code=bfcm45.
  • Since customers forget the coupon codes or apply the wrong ones, URL coupons eliminate this problem, making the redemption process easier.
  • Share URL coupons through emails, social media, and other channels to make it easy for customers to redeem discounts with a simple click.
  • Add coupon URL coupons on buttons, images, pop ups, sidebar, ads – wherever you can put a link, you can put a URL coupon!
  • QR code coupons – Add URL to QR code (use any QR generator app or website) and share the QR code online or offline and allow customers to redeem the discount. 
  • Allow guest users also to redeem the coupon automatically.
  • Add coupons by link for specific products or product categories for targeted conversions.

Quick and easy setup

  • Download, install and activate this extension.
  • Create a coupon, set restrictions and limits and publish.
  • You’ll see the URL with the coupon code under the ‘Coupon Shareable link’ box. 
  • Copy the URL and share where required.
  • You can also view and copy each coupon’s URL directly from the Coupons dashboard by hovering over the coupon.

Unlock advanced URL coupon features in the PRO version

Check out the premium version of URL Coupons by Smart Coupons for WooCommerce, the official Smart Coupons plugin by StoreApps, for more flexibility and advanced options.

Add products to cart via URL

Assign products to the URL coupon, so when users click, the items are instantly added to their cart with discounts applied.

Apply gift card/store credit via URL

With Smart Coupons, you can include a gift card or store credit coupon to the URL and apply the discount.

Redirect to cart, checkout or specific pages

Redirect users to the cart page, checkout page, blogs, landing pages – any custom page when the coupon URL is clicked.

Apply multiple coupon codes via URL

Surprise customers with more promotions. Add coupons to the link separated by a comma like this – https://www.example.com/?coupon-code=cyber35,holiday20,exclusive5&sc-page=bfcmdeals.

Track URL coupons performance

Add UTM parameters to the URL coupon and track its performance using Google Analytics. For example – https://www.example.com/?coupon-code=sale20&sc-page=coffeemug&utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=ad&utm_campaign=new-coffeemug-launch.

Add conditional URL coupons 

Restrict URL coupons by payment methods, shipping methods, user roles, product attributes and others for targeted conversions.

BOGO deals, discount rules and more

Save $500+ with Smart Coupons. It’s an all in one solution, eliminating the need of buying multiple advanced coupons plugins.

Get gift cards, store credits, cashbacks, bulk discounts, buy one get one deals, discount rules, advanced restrictions, flash sales and more…all in a single powerful package.

Why StoreApps?

  • Official WooCommerce extensions developer
  • Consistent 5-star reviews, 14+ years in the business
  • Highly-rated human support
  • Quality code, 330K+ happy customers
sections.installation:
1. Unzip and upload contents of the plugin to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Marketing > Coupons. Open any coupon for editing. You will find the Coupon URL under Coupon shareable link. Use button Click to copy to copy the coupon URL.
  4. Additionally, you can copy coupon URL from the coupon list page. Go to Marketing > Coupons, hover your cursor on the coupon & click on Get shareable link
sections.faq:
What is a URL coupon?

A URL coupon is a special link with a promo code that automatically applies a discount code when a customer clicks on it.

How to create a coupon code link?

Use this extension, create a coupon and publish. You’ll find the required coupon code link

How do I display coupons on the WooCommerce checkout page?

You need the Smart Coupons plugin to show coupons on the checkout page. Here’s how.
